title: Synthetic noisy single-dose IV bolus plasma PK
description: Synthetic plasma concentrations for a one-compartment IV bolus with multiplicative noise. Dose = 1 mg, CL = 0.40 L/h, V = 2.0 L. Quantified values were drawn once from C(t) * exp(0.10 * z) using random.Random(20261030) and rounded to 8 decimal places. The 24 h sample is below the 0.01 ug/mL LLOQ and is stored as BLQ. This is not an animal experiment and not a dosing recommendation.
